description: Abstract class defining cache management for HTMLPurifier definitions, including methods for generating keys, checking cache validity, and managing cache entries.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache
classes.description: Abstract class for managing definition cache with methods for key generation, validation, and cache operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes cache with a specific type of definition objects.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key based on configuration version, batch serial, and revision.

methods.name: isOld
methods.description: Determines if a cache key is outdated compared to current configuration.

methods.name: checkDefType
methods.description: Verifies if a definition's type matches the cache's type.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method to add a definition object to the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Abstract method to unconditionally save a definition object to the cache.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Abstract method to replace an object in the cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a definition object from the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a definition object from the cache.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Abstract method to clear all objects from the cache.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Abstract method to remove expired cache entries.
